Supplementary Figure S7 - Resolving discordances in ctDNA detection between PCM and HPV assays in training and test sets

David N Brown, Bill H Diplas

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

25 June, 2026




Supplementary Figure S7a Distribution of insert sizes of read pairs aligned to HPV-16 for PCM+ve / HPV-ve samples in the ingroup test set.




Supplementary Figure S7b Distribution of insert sizes of read pairs aligned to HPV-16 for samples in the outgroup test set i.e. HPV-18, -33, -35, -58.




Supplementary Figure S7c Distribution of insert sizes of read pairs aligned to HPV-16 for PCM-ve / HPV+ve samples, which exhibiting a broad distribution between 75–100 bp.




Supplementary Figure S7d Scatter plot showing the correlation between the raw number of cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs and the ctDNA fraction.




Supplementary Figure S7e Scatter plot showing the correlation between the number of cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs adjusted for primary tumor HPV copies and the ctDNA fraction.
